title: Vishwas Refoils Consumer IPO
summary: Vishwas Refoils Consumer IPO is a ₹25.78 crore book-built issue priced at ₹85–₹90 per share, to be listed on BSE SME. The IPO opens on December 3, 2026 and closes on December 7, 2026, with allotment expected on December 8 and listing on December 10, 2026. The minimum investment is ₹2,88,000 for 3,200 shares.

b.p: Vishwas Refoils Consumer IPO is priced at ₹85-90 per share with a total issue size of 25.78 crore. The IPO has a lot size of 1600 shares and will be listed on BSE SME.

Vishwas Refoils Consumer financials show revenue growth and profitability trends over recent years, indicating business stability.

Incorporated on March 18, 2023, Vishwas Refoils & Consumer Limited is into processing, manufacturing and packing of edible oils. The range of products offered includes refined palmolein, sunflower, groundnut, cottonseed, corn, castor, soybean, and rice bran oils, besides filtered mustard oil and mild mustard oil. The company offers its products in different packing modes which include pouches, bottles, jars, and tins under its brand name of “Vishwas”. It also offers the products in bulk mode to food processing units for their requirements. Its products are consumed by households and also in various food processing units including bakeries, snacks manufacturers, hotels, restaurants, and caterers. · · Business Model: · Processing and value addition of refined edible oils · Manufacturing of filtered mustard oil (kachi ghani) and filtered mild mustard oil · Trades in Edible Oil. · · Mainly through wholesalers and direct sale to food processing units, the company sells its products. It has established itself in the market through its regular dealings with wholesalers and retail customers by offering quality products. Based on market situation, it also trades in edible oils. · · As of March 31, 2026, the company had 15 permanent employees.
Mandhiyani Deepak Daulatram, Honey Deepakkumar Mandhiyani are the company's promoters of Vishwas Refoils Consumer.
